topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Oh no, I can't even begin to imagine how this must feel for you. I mean, when we first met, I never thought we'd be facing something like this. I wish there was a way to change things, to make everything stay the same. I know how much you hate change, and moving across the country? That's a whole different level of crazy. I promise, no matter what, I'll make sure we keep in touch. We’ll plan visits, video calls, and everything. It's just... I know it won't be the same. And that's what hurts the most. You've been there for everything, and I hate that I can't do anything to stop this. But just remember, no distance can change how much I value our friendship.
